core.round_function: lo0,hi0=mulhilo32(M0,ctr0); lo1,hi1=mulhilo32(M1,ctr2); out=(hi1^ctr1^key0, lo1, hi0^ctr3^key1, lo0); then key0+=W0; key1+=W1 between rounds
core.output_word_order: lane0,lane1,lane2,lane3 as produced by the official round permutation

namespace.rng_namespace_key: explicit uint64; identical only when common-random-number coupling is intentional

key_codec.formula: philox_key64 = rng_namespace_key64 XOR pack_le(world_uid32, domain_id16, semantic_epoch16)
key_codec.pack_le: world_uid in bits[31:0], domain_id in bits[47:32], semantic_epoch in bits[63:48]
key_codec.invariant: For a fixed namespace key and semantic epoch, distinct world/domain pairs map injectively to Philox keys.

counter_codec.serialization: four little-endian uint32 words of the packed uint128
counter_codec.reuse_policy: Duplicate key/counter/lane within one semantic run is a fatal contract violation.
counter_codec.exhaustion_policy: Return RNG_ADDRESS_EXHAUSTED and publish no state; never wrap or use a biased fallback.

subject_identity.persistent_entity: monotonic world-local entity UID; never reused after death or slot recycling
subject_identity.world_event: subject_uid 0 where the domain declares world ownership
subject_identity.ephemeral_event: stable rank in canonical semantic tuple order within world/tick/domain
subject_identity.pair_event: stable rank after sorting the canonical parent/entity UID tuple and occurrence
subject_identity.birth_proposal: stable proposal rank from parent UIDs and proposal ordinal before random outcomes
subject_identity.accepted_child: new entity UID assigned by prefix scan over accepted proposals in canonical proposal order

proposed_domain_registry.name: NON_TRAJECTORY_DIAGNOSTIC
proposed_domain_registry.subject: diagnostic event; forbidden from state evolution

registry_rules: Domain and operation IDs are append-only and never repurposed.
A change in semantic meaning requires a new ID or semantic epoch.
Unknown domain IDs fail closed before generation.
Operation IDs name semantic instances such as locus, action, or pair component; they are not loop indices unless the loop index is itself frozen semantic identity.

branch_rules.untaken_branch: generates and consumes nothing; all unrelated addresses remain unchanged
branch_rules.taken_branch: uses only its declared domain/operation/slot addresses
branch_rules.algorithmic_retry: uses the next addressed word ordinal within the same operation
branch_rules.counterfactual_coupling: explicitly share namespace/domain/address identity only where common random numbers are intended

uniforms.binary64_half_open: u64 = lane_lo | (lane_hi << 32); q53 = u64 >> 11; result = double(q53) * 0x1p-53
uniforms.rounding: IEEE-754 round-to-nearest ties-to-even; conversions are in-range
uniforms.zero_policy: half-open maps include 0 and exclude 1; open radius maps exclude 0 and 1

bounded_integer.threshold: t = uint32(0u - n) % n; reject while low32(x*n) < t after the l < n gate
bounded_integer.retry_addressing: candidate retry r uses word_ordinal r; implementations may evaluate batches but commit the first accepted retry
bounded_integer.n_equals_1: return 0 without drawing a word; accepted_ordinal=0
bounded_integer.n_equals_2_power_32: return raw uint32 under the same operation at word_ordinal 0
bounded_integer.bias_policy: no modulo fallback and no fixed-cap substituted value
bounded_integer.retry_overflow: word_ordinal that would require draw_block > 65535 returns RNG_ADDRESS_EXHAUSTED

normal.raw_input: one Philox block (draw_block=0) supplies two binary64 uniforms from lanes 0-3
normal.single_output: select a named pair component and discard the other without affecting any address
normal.scale_shift: round sigma*z, then round +mu; contraction forbidden

twdmath_1.authority: this contract; vendor libm, glibc, libdevice, and std::normal_distribution are not semantic authorities
twdmath_1.rounding: IEEE-754 binary64 round-to-nearest-even, gradual underflow, no FTZ, no implicit FMA
twdmath_1.sqrt: IEEE-754 required correctly rounded binary64 square root
twdmath_1.log: fdlibm-derived __ieee754_log algorithm with the frozen hex coefficients below; this is a V2-owned copy, not a glibc binding
twdmath_1.sin_cos: fdlibm-derived rem_pio2 + __kernel_sin/__kernel_cos with iy=1 tail from Cody-Waite reduction; V2-owned copy
twdmath_1.contraction: forbidden except named fma_rn nodes (none in PROTO-1)

cpu_gpu_contract.integer: uint32/uint64 only, modulo unsigned overflow, defined shifts, explicit 32x32-to-64 products
cpu_gpu_contract.floating: IEEE binary32/binary64, round-to-nearest-even, gradual underflow, no fast math, no implicit FMA contraction
cpu_gpu_contract.endianness: canonical little-endian serialization independent of host endianness
cpu_gpu_contract.oracle: independent Python integer/IEEE reference plus official Random123 known-answer vectors
cpu_gpu_contract.parity_definition: identical status, raw words, uniforms, bounded values, accepted retry ordinals, normal bits, and consumer digest

consumer_digest.record: world_uid32, domain_id16, epoch16, subject48-in-u64, tick48-in-u64, operation_id16, draw_block16, lane8, status8, payload u64 bits
consumer_digest.gpu_surrogate: specified 64-bit mix used only for kernel timing; conformance digest is SHA-256 of GPU bits on the host

checkpoint.cpu_gpu_handoff: same semantic checkpoint; no RNG state translation
checkpoint.failure_atomicity: late failure publishes nothing; frontier and allocators unchanged; replay after rollback yields identical values

generate_surrogate: The standalone generate kernel emits raw Philox words, one Lemire sample, and one Box-Muller pair from the same operation as a complete-path KAT and timing surrogate. Production consumers must assign distinct operation_ids to distinct semantic draws. Recomputing the same address is intentional CRN or transaction retry, not an accidental alias.
